tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The card's deep green. Ground of the hero and footer in both themes; set `lace` text on it. Taken from a phone photo of the print, so check it against the printer's file.

tokens.name: forest-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of `forest` fills, and the footer's lower strip. Text on it: `lace`.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The olive linen panel inside the lace frame. Hero panel and small brand accents. `lace` text on it passes at 5:1; never `ink-muted` or `sage` text on it.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Soft tint for secondary text on `forest` (dates, captions; 6.9:1) and for quiet decorative fills on `ivory`. Not a text colour on light grounds.

tokens.name: lace
tokens.usage: The white of the lace and the card's lettering. All text on `forest`, `forest-deep` and `moss`.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm paper white: the reading ground for long pages (schedule, travel, FAQ). Same value as `surface` in the Ivory theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands and the footer of long pages.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` (11:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (captions, helper text, small print) on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` (5.3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section rules and card outlines. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of outline buttons on `surface` and `surface-raised` (3:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover and press.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px solid keyboard focus ring, 3px from the element. 4.9:1 or better on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-names
styles.usage: The couple's names in the hero, once per page. 64px under 600px wide.

styles.name: script-small
styles.usage: Event names on schedule cards and the navigation monogram.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a script title, as on the card.

styles.name: details
styles.usage: Uppercase venue, date and time lines.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Uppercase navigation links and button labels.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We can't wait to celebrate with you on Waiheke.
styles.usage: The opening paragraph of a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Ferries leave regularly, so plan to arrive with time to spare.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between link text and its underline.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an eyebrow and its title; icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between the heading rule's diamond and its lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap between paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; button side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards and bands are square, like the printed card.

cut.note: Chamfered corners, taken from the clipped corners of the moss panel inside the lace frame. Apply with clip-path, not border-radius.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Corner cut on schedule cards.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Corner cut on the hero panel and large framed images.

tokens.name: measure-text
tokens.usage: Running text.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Navigation and card grids.
